name: Shelly BLU RC Button 4 ZB
summary: Four-button battery remote with magnetic wall/flat holder; KB data describes the Bluetooth-only US model.

requires: Shelly BLE gateway (any Shelly Plus/Pro/Gen3/Gen4 device) or a Zigbee coordinator

extra.kb_mismatch: Family is 'BLU RC Button 4 ZB' (Zigbee) but kb_slug 'shelly-blu-rc-button-4-us' documents model SBBT-004CUS with Bluetooth 4.2 only — no Zigbee radio in specs. Zigbee support inferred only from product name, not asserted.
extra.holders: magnetic holder for wall switch box (105x44mm) and flat surface included

gotchas: Spec data is from the Bluetooth-only US variant; Zigbee capability implied by the 'ZB' name is unverified
No Wi-Fi — needs a Shelly BLE gateway (any Plus/Pro/Gen3/Gen4 device nearby) to trigger anything over the network
CR2032 coin cell (~2 years); BLE range ~10m indoors
Pairing requires holding two buttons 10s; factory reset only right after inserting battery
best_for: Battery 4-scene wall 'switch' stuck over an existing box, next to a Shelly relay acting as gateway
